paite: Huai lou in leng Israel heutute tungtang ah suunna la phuah ahi;
heading: Dahla
english: “Moreover, take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,

paite: Na nu bang ahia ahih? Humpinelkaipi ahi! Humpinelkaite lak ah akual a, humpinelkai lunlaite lak ah anoute avaklian hi.
english: and say, ‘What was your mother? A lioness. She couched among lions, in the middle of the young lions she nourished her cubs.

paite: Huan anoute lak ah khat avaktei a; humpinelkai lun lai ahong hi; samat asiam a, mite anegai hi.
english: She brought up one of her cubs. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.

paite: Namte'n leng atanchin aza ua; akokhuk uah mat in a-om; huan Aigupta gam ah sikkawi in amah api uh.
english: The nations also heard of him. He was taken in their pit; and they brought him with hooks to the land of Egypt.

paite: Huchi in angak a, alametna avuaksuak chih atheih in, anoute lak ah khat ala a, humpinelkai lun lai in abawl hi.
english: “‘Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her cubs, and made him a young lion.

paite: Humpinelkai lak ah apaisuk paitou a, humpinelkai lun lai ahong hi a; samat asiam a, mite anegai hi.
english: He went up and down among the lions. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.

paite: Ama'n a-inpi kisesate uh athei a, akhopite uh ahihgawp a, gam asegawp a, ahumham husa ziak in, huai a tengteng.
english: He knew their palaces, and laid waste their cities. The land was desolate with its fullness, because of the noise of his roaring.

paite: Huchi in bialte a kipan in ning chih a namte'n amah adou ua; atung ah alen uh azak ua; akokhuk uah mat in a-omta hi.
english: Then the nations attacked him on every side from the provinces. They spread their net over him. He was taken in their pit.

paite: Sikkawite in bawm sung ah akoih ua; Babulon kumpipa kiang ah api ua; kulh muanhuaite sung ah apilut uh; huchi a Israel tang sangte tung a aw akizak nawnlouhna ding in.
english: They put him in a cage with hooks, and brought him to the king of Babylon. They brought him into strongholds, so that his voice should no more be heard on the mountains of Israel.

paite: Na nu na sisan a grepgui bang ahi, tuite kiang a suan; tui tampite ziak in gahpha leh hiangte in adim.
english: “‘Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters. It was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.

paite: Huan vaihawmna pote lalchiang sikchiang khauh a nei in, nah bawkpha lak ah asandan uh hihsang in a-om hi, huchi in ahiang tampite uh toh sangpi amuh in a-om uhi.
english: It had strong branches for the scepters of those who ruled. Their stature was exalted among the thick boughs. They were seen in their height with the multitude of their branches.

paite: Himahleh thangpaihna a bohkhiak in a-om a, lei ah paihkhiak in a-om a, suahlam huih in agah amutkeu a; akung khauhte kitan in akeu a; mei in amaute akang beita.
english: But it was plucked up in fury. It was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up its fruit. Its strong branches were broken off and withered. The fire consumed them.

paite: Huan tu in gamdai ah, gamkeu leh tui om lou ah phuh in a-om.
english: Now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.

paite: Huchi in ahiang a sikchiang a pan mei apaikhia, agah ahulbei a, huchi in amah ah vaihawm ding in lalchiang ding sikchiang khauh a-om kei hi. Hiai kahla ahi, kahla a dia sak ahi ding hi.
english: Fire has gone out of its branches. It has devoured its fruit, so that there is in it no strong branch to be a scepter to rule.’ This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.”
